feeds.title: Frugal and Thriving Blog
feeds.description: I am an Australian frugal living writer. Good living doesn't have to be expensive. In fact, as the saying goes, the good things in life are free! Frugal and Thriving is all about living the good life for less. Foster a healthy and happy home in any financial situation.

feeds.title: The Thrifty Issue Blog
feeds.description: The Thrifty Issue, a beacon for Aussie mums, champions financial independence and control. Through savvy money management and resourceful tips, it empowers women to navigate life's financial terrain confidently. With a diverse team of Aussie mum writers, it offers a treasure trove of insights, experiences, recipes, and side gigs, fostering a community dedicated to making and saving more.

feeds.title: Frugal Frolicker
feeds.description: Featuring travel adventures around the world, travel photography, budget travel tips, and travel guides. Frugal Frolicker is a travel blog by Lindsay Buckley.

feeds.title: Savings Room Blog
feeds.description: Mummy blogger and author obsessed with saving time and never paying full price.

feeds.title: Mum's Money
feeds.description: Increase your income, reduce your spending and go fiercely after the life you are meant to be living. A personal finance blog for go-getters.

feeds.title: Smart Money, Simple Life
feeds.description: Covers frugal living tips for a life of simplicity and financial self reliance.

feeds.title: The Thrifty Life
feeds.description: Thrive with a thrifty life! Discover ways for Aussies to make and save money, delicious recipes and more. The Thrifty Life is a place to share my experiences on thriving while living a thrifty life. I want to inspire others that you really can thrive with a thrifty life! On here you will find the ways that I make and save money, from budgeting tips to recipes and more, all personally used and implemented over the years by us to reach our big financial goals, and which we continue to use to reach our goal of financial independence (FIRE).

feeds.title: Frugal Beans
feeds.description: Frugal living in Sydney Australia. Saving Money Blog discovering the benefits of frugal living whilst enjoying our lives thinking outside of our wallet.
